subject.title: Gateway silently skips channel initialization on plugin/runtime mismatch or missing module files

question: What startup contract should Gateway use when an explicitly configured channel plugin fails before channel registration?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the repair choice changes operator experience: warn-and-continue, fail-fast, and hot-reload behavior have different compatibility and support consequences.

options.title: Warn and audit configured channels
options.body: Keep Gateway running, but add a startup audit that lists configured channels attempted, loaded, and unavailable with plugin diagnostic and doctor guidance.

options.title: Fail fast for explicit channels
options.body: Treat explicitly configured channel plugin incompatibility as a startup blocker with a hard error and recovery command.

options.title: Split broader requests first
options.body: Track hot reload, large-skill-set caching, and external API timeout health separately, then keep this issue scoped to startup visibility.

recommendation.title: Warn and audit configured channels
recommendation.body: Keep Gateway running, but add a startup audit that lists configured channels attempted, loaded, and unavailable with plugin diagnostic and doctor guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current partial warning path that maintainers would likely extend or intentionally replace.
